notes.title: FREE Update, OST, Wallpaper Pack, More!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, long time no see!

First off, a HUGE thank you from the bottom of our hearts for all the love and support you've shown Sunset Hills! It's your passion that keeps us going. ːSpeech_Loveː

We've been listening closely to all your feedback since launch – the cheers, the suggestions, and even the constructive criticism – and we're ready to show our appreciation. We've been hard at work crafting more of the Sunset Hills story and experience you've been craving... ːsteamthumbsupː

We've got BIG plans for Sunset Hills, including future chapters, more localizations, enhanced Steam features, Steam Deck support, a Nintendo Switch release, and even a mobile launch! ːGhostFlowerHappyː

[b][h1]Free Content Update Incoming![/h1][/b]

Get ready! We're dropping a [b]FREE update[/b] for the Steam version of Sunset Hills in [b]early April[/b]!

This update includes story content to address some of those plot points you felt were missing, along with some quality-of-life improvements to make your gameplay even smoother. 

PLUS, we're officially launching a [b]FREE mini-soundtrack[/b] and a [b]FREE wallpaper pack[/b]! We think these additions will seriously enhance your Sunset Hills experience.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3399560
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3174350

[b][h1]Mobile Launch Coming Soon![/h1][/b]

This summer, we're bringing Sunset Hills to [b]mobile[/b]! Get ready to experience the story on both [b]Android and iOS[/b] devices.

If you're hyped for mobile, hit those pre-register links below and follow our official channels to be among the first to play!

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id1523616156

Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cottongame.sunsethills


Our goal is to support and update the game for a long time, and we're listening all your valuable feedback.

We've taken everything you've said to heart. Less talk, more action – we're committed to proving it! ːmlrem3ː

Stay tuned for even MORE good news in the coming weeks. Thanks for being such an awesome community! Nico's with you all! ːtobdogː

notes.title: Sunset Hills Release Only 2 Days Left! Soundtrack Under Expedited Review!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Only two days until Sunset Hills is out！

The original soundtrack is under expedited review and we hope it'll be available with the game. 

Add Sunset Hills to your wishlist to help us reach the Steam charts and inspire us to create more great works. Let's look forward to the journey with Nico!

Nico and the Sunset Hills Team

notes.title: Update for Sunset Hills Japanese Support
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550174/03b7f90ca91bfce9d4a9504661070f902a16df92.jpg[/img]
It's great news that Sunset Hills is coming to Steam on October 3, 2024 in Japanese! Thank you for your patience. We will also be attending the Tokyo Game Show (TGS) from September 26 to September 29, 2024, so please come visit us at booth 09-W62 in the Hall9 Indie Games section.

The Japanese localization of Sunset Hills has already been completed for a while, and both the Cotton Game and Asmik Ace teams wish to offer the best localization quality we can,  which will take 2-3 months for the internal testing & beta testing then make some optimizations before we release the Japanese version. We hope with the game release, we can have more players who speak English and Japanese join our localization testing and give us valuable feedback.

We look forward to seeing you all at the show!

By : Cotton Game & Asmik Ace, Inc. (Japan)
2024/8/13
[url=https://x.com/SunsetHills2022]X[/url]

notes.title: Sunset Hills Release Date Reveal
notes.notes:
Hello passengers，

I'm the conductor of the Southern Express, and I'd like to say a few brief words before we head out. Our train is confirmed to be officially departing this summer 2024 (first on PC and Switch)!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1791590/_/

As the first passengers of the Southern Express, you'll be travelling through the beautiful town of Tobic and the bustling city of Hepburn.

The sights and characters of all shapes and sizes outside the windows of the car and in the towns will be some of the most valuable assets you'll have on this journey.

After all, it's not the destination that counts, it's the scenery along the way.

Please wait a little while for the journey to begin!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42550174/9bb9133f649f764e01f1dff56f33f66d4e0b4884.jpg[/img]
